rules.expression: (http.request.method eq "GET" and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/wp-admin") and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/wp-json") and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/wp-login") and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/ia/devis") and not any(http.request.headers["cookie"][*] contains "wordpress_logged_in") and not any(http.request.headers["cookie"][*] contains "wp-postpass") and not any(http.request.headers["cookie"][*] contains "comment_author"))
